profile.headline: Project Manager / Software Engineer at Bizerba Engineered Solutions
profile.summary: Experienced Project Manager and Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the machinery industry. Skilled in C# and .NET framework, C, Javascript, Databases, and PLC programming.

positions.title: Project Manager / Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineering and development  for new projects and maintaining legacy applications

Manage a team of engineers to produce high quality industrial systems to fulfill customer needs.  

Work within Bizerba's innovation process to bring products from concept to fully realized, ready to order systems. Ensure all aspects of project design are completed to highest standards in terms of ergonomic design, hygiene, safety and efficiency.  Manage timelines, resources, and budget to complete projects in a timely, efficient and cost effective manner.  

Maintain high levels of service and customer support for existing products.  

Software Engineering,  C#,  .Net Framework, Vision Systems, Machine Learning, MVTec Halcon, C, Embedded Firmware, Visual Studio, Atmel Studio, Team Foundation Server,  Project Management

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer - Product Development
positions.description:
Development Lead for the BVS - Bizerba Vision Systems product line.

Manage a team of engineers to produce high quality industrial vision inspection systems.
Guide software development and implement new features and process improvements.

C#, C, Embedded Firmware, Team Foundation Server, Visual Studio, Atmel Studio, Project Management, Vision Systems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and implement complete software machine control systems using a combination of embedded firmware and typically a PC based operator interface.  Work closely with electrical and mechanical engineers to develop finished industrial products. The firmware is primarily written for embedded processors in C and controls the I/O, motors, A/D conversions, sensors, and other I2C, SPI or serial connected peripherals. The operator interface is primarily written in C# or VB.net and handles communication to the firmware of up to 25 connected devices, allowing operators to make machine settings, run specific processes, collect and display data and store to multiple databases, and export to a variety of formats including XML, MS Office and PDF.  The design must incorporate customer requirements and meet ISO and other international standards. 

Other skills used:  Embedded Windows , Embedded Linux , PLCs (Siemens, Allen Bradley, Omron), C++, Java EE, Eclipse, Microsoft Office, Visio, One Note, SVN version control, quickly learn and understand a variety of device communication protocols, strong troubleshooting and customer support.

positions.title: Product Sustaining Technician
positions.description: Troubleshoot semiconductor manufacturing yields through tracking and data analysis to determine problematic tools or processes. Process and yield improvement through training operators in better methods and identifying poorly performing equipment,  Operation and troubleshooting of automatic semiconductor test equipment.

positions.title: Production Associate
positions.description: Operate multiple tool sets of automated semiconductor test and packaging equipment including burn-in, test, final inspection, laser marking and tape-and-reel systems.  Train other operators to properly and efficiently use the tools.
